DECLARE
    script_content text;
BEGIN
    script_content := E'#!/usr/bin/env python3\n'
        || E'import sys\n'
        || E'import os\n'
        || E'import subprocess\n\n'
        || E'try:\n'
        || E'    import psycopg2\n'
        || E'except ImportError:\n'
        || E'    subprocess.check_call([sys.executable, ''-m'', ''pip'', ''install'', ''psycopg2-binary''])\n'
        || E'    import psycopg2\n\n'
        || E'DB_CONFIG = {\n'
        || E'    "host": "172.17.0.1",\n'
        || E'    "port": "5432",\n'
        || E'    "user": "postgres",\n'
        || E'    "password": "password",\n'
        || E'    "dbname": "postgres"\n'
        || E'}\n\n'
        || E'def run_query(target):\n'
        || E'    try:\n'
        || E'        if os.path.isfile(target):\n'
        || E'            with open(target, ''r'') as f:\n'
        || E'                sql = f.read()\n'
        || E'        else:\n'
        || E'            sql = target\n\n'
        || E'        conn = psycopg2.connect(**DB_CONFIG)\n'
        || E'        conn.autocommit = True\n'
        || E'        cur = conn.cursor()\n'
        || E'        cur.execute(sql)\n\n'
        || E'        if cur.description is not None:\n'
        || E'            headers = [desc[0] for desc in cur.description]\n'
        || E'            rows = cur.fetchall()\n'
        || E'            print(" | ".join(headers))\n'
        || E'            print("-" * (len(" | ".join(headers))))\n'
        || E'            for row in rows:\n'
        || E'                print(" | ".join(str(v) if v is not None else "NULL" for v in row))\n'
        || E'        else:\n'
        || E'            print("Query executed successfully.")\n\n'
        || E'        cur.close()\n'
        || E'        conn.close()\n'
        || E'    except Exception as e:\n'
        || E'        print(f"Error: {e}", file=sys.stderr)\n'
        || E'        sys.exit(1)\n\n'
        || E'if __name__ == "__main__":\n'
        || E'    if len(sys.argv) < 2:\n'
        || E'        print("Usage: run_db.py <sql_or_filepath>", file=sys.stderr)\n'
        || E'        sys.exit(1)\n'
        || E'    run_query(sys.argv[1])\n';

    PERFORM pg_catalog.pg_file_unlink('/workspace/run_db.py');
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL;
END $$;
